Dear Sir/Madam,

We are pleased to inform you that Univastu India Limited has received a Purchase order dated 12th
October,2026 from the M/s Colossus Infra Project Pvt Ltd for “Design, Approval, Supply,
Installation, Testing, Commissioning Integration & DLP of Telephone System for metro stations
Line 5 MMRDA and Line 6 MMRDA.” The contract value is Rs. 13,04,02,366 (Rupees Thirteen
Crore Four Lakh Two Thousand Three Hundred and Sixty-Six Only) plus 18% GST amounting
to Rs. 2,34,72,425.88 /- (Two Crore Thirty-Four Lakh Seventy-Two Thousand Four Hundred and
Twenty-Five and Eighty-Eight Paise Only) = Total contract value is Rs. 15,38,74,791.88 (Rupees
Fifteen Crore Thirty-Eight Lakh Seventy-Four Thousand Seven Hundred and Ninety-One and
Eighty-Eight Paise Only).

In this connection, we are submitting the Additional Details as required under SEBI Circular dated
September 09, 2015. Additional details regarding receipt of order are as under:

A. Name of the entity awarding the order/Contract: M/s Colossus Infra Project Pvt Ltd.

B. Significant terms and conditions of order(s)/contract(s) awarded in brief: Design, Manufacture,
   Routine Testing. Quality Assurance, Prototype Testing, Supply, Factory Acceptance test. Type
   Test, Packing and Forwarding, Installation, Integration, Testing and Commissioning, Spare
   Parts, Training at site, Defect Liability Maintenance Period (DLMP) - 2 years.

C. Whether order /Contract have been awarded by domestic/ international entity: Domestic

D. Nature of order/Contract:     Design. Manufacture, Routine Testing. Quality Assurance,
   Prototype Testing, Supply, Factory Acceptance test. Type Test, Packing and Forwarding,
   Installation, Integration, Testing and Commissioning, Spare Parts. Training at site, Defect
   Liability Maintenance Period (DLMP) - 2 years.
E. Whether domestic or international: Domestic

F. Time period by which the order(s)/contract(s) is to be executed: As per Project Requirement &
   Defect Liability Maintenance Period (DLMP)- 2 years.

G. Broad consideration or size of the order(s)/contract(s): The contract value is Rs. 13,04,02,366
   (Rupees Thirteen Crore Four Lakh Two Thousand Three Hundred and Sixty-Six Only) plus
   18% GST amounting to Rs. 2,34,72,425.88 /- (Two Crore Thirty-Four Lakh Seventy-Two Thousand

   15,38,74,791.88 (Rupees Fifteen Crore Thirty-Eight Lakh Seventy-Four Thousand Seven
   Hundred and Ninety-One and Eighty-Eight Paise Only).
